Help to keep the book trosh end oloan --- Page 3 --- KASHALNTEM PART - I ary CHECKED --- Page 5 --- Ka Jinglamphrang Wat la ngam shym la long kaba la nang la stad ha ki kyrdan pule, hynrei kum ka briew kaba la kyrkhu da U Blei, Tral Kynrad, Nongbuh Nongthaw, uba la al la nga ia ka sap, nga la thoh ia ki Poetry bad ki Jingrwal Nga ku ah ban pynsngew sa shisien lyngba ine ki kot lyngkdon 'Ka Shalyntem" Part II ha phi ki khun ka Ri, ki khynnah, ki samla samhoi, ki tymmen ki san ban ia pule sngewtynnad bad ban ia thir lem ia ki ksal jingpyrkhat kiba mih na ka dohnud ba lung jong nga Mano kein haba ki jingmut ki kyrsoi ha ka dohnud bad ki sur ba myllung ki sawa ha ki shkor ban khiem kynud ia ki bad ban pyrta la ki ktien ?

Kumta ka long ianga ba ha kano kano ka por ba wan ka Jingpyrsad mynsiem la ka long na ka mariang bad kiel kiel kiba don ha ka, ki kshaid, ki lum ki wah, ki syntiew ki skud kiba itynnad, nga kyrmen ba kane kan plie lem ia ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong phi ki nongpule ban sumar ban khein kordor la ki matti U Blei Uba la al ei kat kane ka Ri ba itynnad jong ngi Ha ka imlang sahlang ban sumar ia la ki rympel khnang ba kin mih k Rangkynsai bad ki Thei kynsai ki ban pynphuh pynphieng ia la ka jong ka jaid bynriew Ka jingnang jingstad kaba donkam ban khein kordor bad ka jingiatyll kum ka jaid --- Page 6 --- bynriew kaba ngam lah khlem da kyntu lyngba ki poetry jong nga Ka rep ka riang ban ym iehnoh ia ka, ki khanatang ba sngewtynnad ba la iathuh da ki longshuwa man shuwa bad bun kiwei kiwei kiba phi ki nongpule phin sa shem ynda phi la pyntyllun ia ka “Ka Shalyntem” Ha ka jingtre1 jong nga kaba nga la pynlut da ki snem, nga ngeit ba kane ka jingpynmih jong nga a kane “Ka Shalyntem"” kan long ka jingpynkhie im ia ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong phi ki nongpule Khublei Shibun Kong Listrimal Syiemlieh --- Page 7 --- PART I CONTENTS SKER PAGE U Tirot Singh 1.
Jingieit ka Kmie Baje u Khar Switmit 7.
Ka Rep Kba Surok Kyllain Khongdong 26 33 27 Thylliej khlem Shyieng 34 PEOTRY 27.
Ka Jingkit khlieh 44 --- Page 9 --- U TIROT SINGH U Tirot Sing'.

u Sylem Nongkhlaw Ka nam jong u mynta ka ial paw Haduh kine ki sng1 ngim klet Jingshlur jong u ngin bud syrwet, Na baroh katba tip ma ng1 Dei une na ki Syiem Khasi U shah shitom la la ka ri U Tirot Singh u Syien jong ng!

U Tirot Singh u Syiem ba shiur Hapdeng Jingeh baroh u tur Une u ieng ban da I'u pait Na bynta hima hok u said, Da lade hi u leng laleh L'u pait u lam nongshun ban beh U Shah shitom ia la ka Ri U Tirot Singh u Syiern jong ng!
U Tirot Singh U Riew ialeh Nongshun na la ka ri u beh Sh1 syrtap dohnud u mut hok Nongshun ki pah, ban wan la lok.
Jingthmu jong k1 ym lah 1oh1 Hima jong u ban ioh kynti U shah shitom la la ka Ri U Tirot Singh u Syiem jong ng!

U Tirot Singh u khraw pyrkhat Kyndit bynriew u sngew peit mat Ryntieh u khnam, ka stieh, u rah B'un mait naphang, un nym pynsah, Nongshun khraw bor ki kem kylla Ki set byndi ha DAHAKA (Dacca) U iap sngewsih ha ling byndi U Tirot Singh u Syiem jong ng!

--- Page 10 --- KI THAPBALIEH Ki Thapbalieh bun rong Kiba mih ha por pyrem, Balieh basaw baiong Ki thapiniang balung ba jem, Ki thapiiang balung ba jem Khorus : Ko thapbalieh, ko thapballeh Naei ph wan naei phi muh, Shano phin her shano phun her Phu swait sawdong ka kper, Phu swaut sawdong ka kper Ko thapbalieh ba rit Jingim ba 1 suk kynjal, Ym don ba wan pynwit Tang jingsuk ia phi kyrhal, Tang jingsuk a phi kyrhal Ko thapbalieh khlik khlik Phi pynkhih la ki thapiiang, Syntiew ba phuh khrik khrik Phi kjit lut ki um bathiang, Phi kjit lut k1 um bathiang Ko thapbalieh - balong Phi 1oh her kat sha bamon, Hangno ph1 im ph1 shong Jingkhuslal imat phim don, Jingkhuslal imat phim don
